title: Broker’s Call: Healthcare Global Enterprises (Buy) - The HinduBusinessLine
text:
The company reported an EBITDA margin of 19.7 per cent, expanding 50 bps from 19.2 per cent (EBITDA of ₹143 crore, up 17 per cent)

HCG delivered revenues of ₹732 crore, growing a steady 16 per cent year on year, supported by broad-based performance across operating clusters; top-line growth was slightly tempered in Gujarat by strategic rationalisation of lower-realisation institutional contracts to improve margins.

The company reported an EBITDA margin of 19.7 per cent, expanding 50 bps from 19.2 per cent (EBITDA of ₹143 crore, up 17 per cent). H1 Adjusted PAT reached ₹29 crore, up 30 per cent, as operational losses narrowed to ₹6.1 crore at the ramping north Bengaluru facility.

Average Revenue Per Patient (ARPP) registered a 7 per cent increase, as positive payor-mix gains (non-institutional mix rising over 300 bps to 69 per cent) were further aided by high-complexity oncology adoption.

Outlook remains strong, with management guiding for mid-teens revenue growth and high-teens EBITDA expansion, going forward. The North Bengaluru facility’s EBITDA loss narrowed to ₹6.1 crore with monthly breakeven slated for Q4-FY27, alongside 146 operational beds added across the network in H1FY27. Margin trajectory remains resilient despite recent oncology drug price caps, driven by non-institutional mix gains and operating efficiencies. Utilisation of rights issue proceeds funded the strategic Visakhapatnam buyout and enabled ₹170 crore of planned debt reduction.

Current valuation: EV/EBITDA 15.5x for FY29E (earlier: 17.5x/FY28E); current TP: ₹820/share; (₹785/share). We maintain our Buy recommendation on the stock.
